scope: ERNA/C_WITCH only: 54 standard/travel frame semantic rows derived from R003; no AIRA, LUNA, or NOIR rows. Adds distinct freePalm semantics and hand visibility; includes accepted candidate BODY01 hem points and unknown BODY02 lining. No renderer/runtime behavior is implied.

semanticFrameLandmarksCandidate.measurementMethod: 54 source frames SHA-verified and reviewed individually with 16px grid. freeHand is glove/wrist center; freePalm is a separate knuckle/finger center and is populated only where visually distinguishable. Visibility values distinguish visible, occluded, and unknown; no alpha-only semantic inference. Candidate points are approximate and not fit-verified.
